method_card.title: Family and Describing People
method_card.content:
This lesson covers family vocabulary, possessive adjectives and how to describe appearance and personality in French.

FrenchEnglish
le pèrefather
la mèremother
le frèrebrother
la sœursister
le grand-pèregrandfather
la grand-mèregrandmother
l'oncleuncle
la tanteaunt
le cousin / la cousinecousin
le filsson
la filledaughter
le beau-pèrestepfather
la belle-mèrestepmother
le demi-frère / la demi-sœurhalf-brother / half-sister
les parentsparents

Possessive adjectives agree with the noun they describe, not the owner: mon (m. sg.), ma (f. sg.), mes (pl.) = my; son (m. sg.), sa (f. sg.), ses (pl.) = his/her. Important exception: before a feminine noun starting with a vowel or silent h, use mon/ton/son instead of ma/ta/sa — e.g. mon amie (not ma amie).

Describing people: Use avoir for hair and eyes — Il a les cheveux blonds et les yeux bleus. (He has blond hair and blue eyes.) Use être for build and personality — Elle est grande et sympa. (She is tall and nice.) Adjectives must agree in gender and number with the noun they describe.

Model paragraph: Mon père s'appelle Jules. Il a les cheveux courts et bruns et les yeux noisette. Il est grand et très gentil. Ma mère s'appelle Isabelle. Elle est petite et amusante. (My father is called Jules. He has short brown hair and hazel eyes. He is tall and very kind. My mother is called Isabelle. She is short and fun.)
steps: Learn the key family members in masculine and feminine pairs
Master possessive adjectives — mon/ma/mes, son/sa/ses — and the vowel exception
Practise describing physical appearance using avoir (hair, eyes) and être (build)
Write full sentences combining family vocabulary, possessives and adjective agreement

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — appears in every exam series

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: 'Mon frère a les cheveux noirs et il est assez grand.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Break the sentence into chunks: Mon frère | a les cheveux noirs | et | il est assez grand.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Mon frère = My brother. a les cheveux noirs = has black hair — use avoir for hair and eyes.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: il est assez grand = he is quite tall — use être for build and height.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: My brother has black hair and he is quite tall.

worked_examples.question: How do you choose between mon, ma and mes?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Look at the noun you are describing — is it masculine singular, feminine singular or plural?

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Masculine singular → mon (e.g. mon père). Feminine singular → ma (e.g. ma mère). Plural → mes (e.g. mes parents).

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Exception: before a feminine noun starting with a vowel, use mon: mon amie — not ma amie.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Possessive adjectives agree with the gender and number of the thing owned, not the owner. Mon (m. sg.), ma (f. sg.), mes (pl.), with the vowel exception for feminine nouns beginning with a vowel.

worked_examples.question: How do you write 'Her sister is kind and has blue eyes' correctly in French?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Start with the possessive adjective: sœur is feminine singular, so use sa — Sa sœur.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: For the adjective gentil with a feminine noun: add -le → gentille. Write: Sa sœur est gentille.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: For eye colour: use avoir — elle a les yeux. Then the adjective bleu must agree with the plural noun yeux: bleus.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Sa sœur est gentille et elle a les yeux bleus.

bronze.question: Match the French family members to the English meaning
Match the French descriptions to the English meaning
Complete the sentence with the correct possessive adjective
sentence_parts: mère s'appelle Isabelle. J'ai deux frères —

gaps.correct_explain: Mon is correct because père is masculine singular.

wrong.Ma: Ma is feminine — père is masculine, so you need Mon.
wrong.Mes: Mes is plural — père is singular, so you need Mon.

gaps.correct_explain: ma is correct because mère is feminine singular.

wrong.mes: mes is plural — mère is singular, so you need ma.
wrong.mon: mon is masculine — mère is feminine and starts with a consonant, so use ma.

wrong.ma: ma is feminine singular — frères is plural, so you need mes.
wrong.mon: mon is singular — frères is plural, so you need mes.

bronze.question: Complete the description with the correct word

gaps.correct_explain: cheveux means hair — les cheveux longs = long hair.

wrong.yeux: yeux means eyes, not hair. Les cheveux = hair.

gaps.correct_explain: verts means green — any eye colour adjective is acceptable here.

wrong.vert: vert is singular — les yeux is plural, so the adjective must be verts.

gaps.correct_explain: grande is the feminine form because elle is feminine.

wrong.grand: grand is masculine — elle is feminine, so you need grande.

bronze.question: What does 'Mon grand-père a les cheveux blancs et les yeux marron' mean?
options: My grandfather has white hair and brown eyes
My grandmother has brown hair and white eyes
My grandfather has brown hair and blue eyes
My grandmother has blond hair and brown eyes

bronze.question: Which is the correct way to say 'Her brother is funny but lazy'?
options: Son frère est amusant mais paresseux
Sa frère est amusante mais paresseuse
Ses frère est amusant mais paresseux
Son frère est amusante mais paresseuse

bronze.source_text: J'ai une sœur qui s'appelle Léa. Elle est drôle mais parfois jalouse.
model_answers: I have a sister called Léa. She is funny but sometimes jealous.
I have a sister who is called Léa. She is funny but sometimes jealous.

silver.question: Complete the sentence by typing the correct word
silver.english: My mother is short and very kind.

gaps.correct_explain: est is the il/elle form of être. Ma mère est... = My mother is...

wrong.a: a is from avoir (to have). For personality and build descriptions, use être.
wrong.es: es is the tu form. Ma mère = elle, so you need est.

gaps.correct_explain: gentille is the feminine form of gentil. Ma mère is feminine — double the L and add -e.

wrong.gentil: gentil is the masculine form. Ma mère is feminine, so you need gentille (double L + E).

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Ma sœur est très gentil et elle a les cheveux longs.
silver.explanation: sœur is feminine, so the adjective must be in the feminine form: gentille (not gentil). Add -le to the masculine form.
silver.translation: My sister is very kind and she has long hair.

silver.question: Build the sentence in French
silver.english: My brother has blue eyes and brown hair.

distractor_labels.Ma: wrong gender — frère is masculine, needs Mon not Ma

silver.source_text: I have a big family. My sister is short and funny.
model_answers: J'ai une grande famille. Ma sœur est petite et amusante.
J'ai une grande famille. Ma sœur est petite et drôle.

gold.english: My stepmother is very nice and she has green eyes.

distractor_labels.Mon: wrong gender — belle-mère is feminine, needs Ma not Mon

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are staying with a French exchange family. Your host parent asks you about your family at home.

bullets.prompt: Say how many people are in your family and name them.
bullets.model_answer: Il y a cinq personnes dans ma famille : mon père, ma mère, mes deux frères et moi.
bullets.note: il y a + number + dans ma famille; list with possessive adjectives

bullets.prompt: Describe your brother or sister's appearance.
bullets.model_answer: Mon frère a les cheveux courts et bruns et les yeux bleus. Il est assez grand.
bullets.note: avoir for hair/eyes, être for build; adjective agreement (bleus, courts, bruns)

bullets.model_answer: Ma mère est très gentille et amusante. Elle est aussi très intelligente.
bullets.note: être + feminine adjective agreement (gentille, amusante, intelligente)

bullets.prompt: Say who you get on well with and why.
bullets.model_answer: Je m'entends bien avec ma sœur parce qu'elle est sympa et drôle.
bullets.note: s'entendre bien avec + parce que + justification

gold.correct_text: J'ai une grande famille. Mon père est grand et il a les cheveux courts. Ma mère est petite et très gentille.
gold.translation: I have a big family. My father is tall and has short hair. My mother is short and very kind.

gold.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
gold.sentence: Son père a les cheveux blonds mais son mère est brune.
gold.explanation: mère is feminine, so the possessive adjective must be sa (not son). Son is used before masculine nouns or feminine nouns starting with a vowel.
gold.translation: His father has blond hair but his mother is brunette.
